name: The governor mode on Setup > Governor > General is shown and set only with the GOVERNOR feature
step: Check the governor mode against the GOVERNOR feature bit
rationale: Issue #2649: the page took the governor mode from MSP_GOVERNOR_CONFIG alone. The firmware starts the governor only with FEATURE_GOVERNOR (BIT 26, src/main/config/feature.h; src/main/fc/init.c), so with the feature off and a stored ELECTRIC mode the page showed ELECTRIC and enabled its fields, and a mode picked there saved a mode that did not run. The page now shows OFF while the feature is off, keeps the stored mode until the pilot picks one, and on save sets the feature to match a picked mode. It restarts the flight controller only when that save changes the feature, because the governor starts at start-up. The harness drives the real setup_governor_general.lua with a stand-in page runtime that loads the governor and feature data, runs onLoaded and then the save steps the runtime runs (beforeSave and the reboot decision). It checks the shown mode and the enabled fields with the feature off and on, that an untouched save changes nothing and does not restart, that a picked mode sets the feature and restarts when it changes it, and that a change between two modes with the feature on does not restart. Its self-test removes the feature test and requires a feature-off board to show ELECTRIC. On the code before the fix the page shows nothing and the checks fail.
